diagnostics.message: :module.csi: explicit depends_on of :module.eks is redundant — already implied by attribute references

:module.csi has an explicit `depends_on = [module.eks]`, but the module already depends on :module.eks through ordinary attribute references (the addon configuration reads `module.eks.cluster.name` as `eks_name` and `module.eks.oidc` for the IRSA provider). The explicit depends_on duplicates a dependency Terraform infers automatically and can be removed.
